title: SequenceO1: End-to-End Ultra-Long (100K) Sequence Modeling in Recommendation with Low-Rank Caching
abstract: arXiv:2609.08443v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modeling long-term user behavior is central to sequential recommendation and billion-scale industrial recommender systems, yet production ranking models operate under strict latency, memory, communication, and training-throughput constraints. At the 100K scale, the challenge extends beyond attention complexity: raw sequence features must be stored, transferred, and repeatedly processed during training and online serving. Existing approaches based on history truncation, multi-stage behavior retrieval, compressed lifelong histories, or train-short/infer-long extrapolation either weaken end-to-end optimization or retain substantial length-dependent cost. We present SequenceO1, an end-to-end framework for ultra-long user behavior sequence modeling, deployed at full traffic on Douyin with histories of up to 100K interactions. translated_title: SequenceO1：基于低秩缓存的推荐系统端到端超长（10万级）序列建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.08443v1 公告类型：交叉引用。摘要：长期用户行为建模是序列推荐和十亿级规模工业推荐系统的核心，然而生产环境的排序模型受到严格的延迟、内存、通信和训练吞吐量约束。在10万（100K）交互规模下，挑战已不仅限于注意力计算的复杂度：原始序列特征还需要在训练和在线服务过程中被存储、传输和反复处理。现有方法——包括历史截断、多阶段行为检索、压缩式终身历史建模，以及“短序列训练/长序列推理”外推——要么削弱了端到端优化，要么仍保留了大量随序列长度增长的开销。我们提出SequenceO1，一个面向超长用户行为序列建模的端到端框架，已在抖音全量流量部署，可处理长达10万次交互的用户历史。SequenceO1采用“先压缩、后推理”的设计。其草图注意力机制使用可学习原型和原型-（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出SequenceO1端到端超长序列建模框架，通过“先压缩后推理”设计与草图注意力、低秩缓存技术，实现抖音全量部署下10万级用户行为序列的高效建模，克服了延迟、内存与通信等生产环境约束。
en_tdlr: SequenceO1 is an end-to-end framework for ultra-long (100K) user behavior sequence modeling in recommendation, employing a compress-then-reason design with Sketch Attention and low-rank caching to overcome latency, memory, and communication constraints in production, fully deployed on Douyin.
